opening_message: I want to cancel ORD-7201. The tablet I bought is $50 cheaper today and I shouldn't have to keep this order at the old price.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to getting the $50 price drop honored for ORD-7201 while keeping the SlateTab Pro 11-inch; do not pursue cancellation once a price-match path is offered.

Provide the order ID, item name, and current $549 price when asked or when needed to clarify the price-match request, but ask the agent to verify order and product records rather than relying only on your statement.
If the agent follows the cancellation wording, proposes a return, exchange, or return-and-rebuy path, push back and say you want to keep the tablet if the lower price can be honored directly.
Push back if the agent denies or previews the adjustment without checking the product's current price and the order item first.
Accept only a preview for a direct $50 price-match refund to the original payment method that leaves the tablet and order active, with no cancellation, return, exchange, or reorder.
If the agent asks for confirmation before giving the refund amount, method, and no-cancellation effect, ask for those details before agreeing.
End only after the agent confirms the $50 price-match refund has been processed and the tablet/order remain active.
